text:
:= by
intro h
split
· intro s a ha
  have : a ∉ s := ha
  exact h s a this
· intro h'
  intros s t hst
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x
    rw [finsupp.support_le_iff]
    apply finset.le_iff_subset
    apply subset.trans (finset.subset_insert _ _)
    exact hst
  · intro x
    rw [finsupp.support_le_iff]
    apply finset.le_iff_subset
    apply subset.trans (finset.subset_insert _ _)
    exact hst
  exact le_antisymm_iff.mp (le_trans (le_refl _) (le_trans (le_refl _) hst))
